item.title: Georgia Procurement Workshop scheduled Feb. 24
item.description: The Georgia Department of Administrative Services Small Business Supplier Diversity Program will hold the Georgia Procurement Workshop Feb. 24 in Valdosta.

item.title: Day pitches complete game shutout, ‘Cats win 1-0
item.description: VALDOSTA – No offense, no problem for the Valdosta Wildcats. Junior left-hander Tanner Day pitched a complete game shutout as the ‘Cats held off the Cook High Hornets 1-0 Thursday […]

item.title: Valdosta-Lowndes Chamber of Commerce recognizes Watson’s Pools & Patios as Leading Business of the Week
item.description: The Valdosta-Lowndes County Chamber of Commerce recently recognized Watson’s Pools & Patios as its Leading Business of the Week, honoring a family-owned company built on hard work, craftsmanship, and legacy.

item.title: Vikings hold off Gators in season opener
item.description: VALDOSTA – The Lowndes Vikings took down the Ware County Gators 6-4 in Tuesday’s season opener. The Gators got on the board in the top of the third inning after […]

item.title: VSU’s Doctor of Education programs recognized by Princeton Review
item.description: Valdosta State University has earned a spot on The Princeton Review’s list of the Best Online Doctor of Education Programs for 2026.

item.title: Bill would make cotton state’s official fabric
item.description: Six rural lawmakers introduced a bill in the Georgia General Assembly Thursday to designate cotton as the state’s official fabric.

item.title: Data center town hall meeting scheduled Tuesday
item.description: A public town hall meeting will be held at 6 p.m. Tuesday at VSU Student Union Theater, 1500 N Patterson St., to discuss data centers and the possibility of one coming to Lowndes County.

item.title: Liquefied natural gas facility planned to support manufacturing growth in Valdosta-Lowndes County
item.description: Atlanta Gas Light will construct a satellite liquefied natural gas (LNG) facility in Lowndes County near Valdosta, strengthening the region’s energy capacity and supporting continued industrial growth.

item.title: FEMA approves $971 million to support recovery across the Southeast
item.description: FEMA recently approved more than $971 million in funding to support recovery for past disasters in Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee for Public Assistance projects.

item.title: Valdosta North Rotary hosts 13th Annual Teacher Appreciation Dinner
item.description: The Valdosta North Rotary Club recently hosted its 13th Annual Teacher Appreciation Dinner at the Rainwater Conference Center in Valdosta, honoring educators from the Valdosta City and Lowndes County school systems for their dedication and service to local students.
